method: Independent Node VM simulation using production entry and arcadeInput/actions. Synthetic level-3 entry, weapons=1. Decisions every 0.45 s (keyboard) or 0.6 s (joystick); at most one target-cycle per decision. No HP edits, teleports or forced victory. No browser/physical phone test.

checks.name: Pause during first warning freezes field, projectiles, positions and clock
Save/restore during warning produces equal outcomes and a single field crossing
First teaching field is reachable by joystick with 0.6-second decisions
